title: Ordinary coordinates for integral tensor and pullback, with compatibility
statement: For D, C, E and a higher operation datum H as in [def-sf-operation-stages], and any compactified square Q, choose ordinary pro-etale tensor models aZ and aY over the completed coefficient sheaves [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. There are natural isomorphisms a from ordinary pullback after constructible inclusion to the supplied proper pullback followed by inclusion, and m,n from the included supplied tensors to the ordinary tensors on included objects. They satisfy CategoryTheory.Adjunction.ComparisonCompatible for the supplied tensor-pullback comparison and the canonical ordinary ringed tensor-pullback comparison. This asserts only compatibility of left-operation functors. It makes no assertion about direct image, adjunction counits, a projection morphism, or its invertibility.

proof.text: Use the fixed signed ordinary tensorModel on Z and Y. The native tensorCompletionComparison supplies forward augmentations with the full representative normalization. tensorComplete_onConstructible makes each augmentation component invertible. Restrict to the full constructible categories, curry, and invert to obtain m and n. The proved ringed pullback comparison is invertible on the same domain, and its natural restriction gives a. Finite type over the specified field gives Noetherianness, compactness, quasi-separatedness, finite dimension and invertibility of the prime in global sections and residue fields.

The forward augmentation square is tensorPullback_augmentation. Naturality of the target augmentation moves the two pullback completion maps to its ordinary-tensor side. Cancel ordinary pullback of the source augmentation and the pullback comparison on the completed tensor, then cancel the target augmentation. This gives the desired inverse comparison square. Substitute the supplied pullback and tensor functor equalities and the componentwise HEq normalization of the supplied tensorPullback to identify it with ComparisonCompatible.

lean.statement:
theorem integralOrdinaryTensorPullbackNormalization
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E]
    (H : SixFunctorHigherOperations D C E) (Q : SixFunctorCompactifiedSquare D) :
    ∃ (aZ : ProEtaleTensorModel Q.Z.obj.left
        ((PurCompactSupport.completed C.l E).ring Q.Z.obj.left))
      (aY : ProEtaleTensorModel Q.Y.obj.left
        ((PurCompactSupport.completed C.l E).ring Q.Y.obj.left))
      (a : (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E Q.Y.obj.left).ι ⋙
          PurCompactSupport.pull (PurCompactSupport.completed C.l E) Q.p.hom.left ≅
        (H.integralExchange Q).stage.properPull ⋙
          (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E Q.Z.obj.left).ι)
      (m : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E Q.Z.obj.left).ι).obj
          (H.integralExchange Q).stage.tensorBar ≅
        (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj
          (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E Q.Z.obj.left).ι).obj
            (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E Q.Z.obj.left).ι).obj
              (Functor.curry.obj aZ.tensor))
      (n : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E Q.Y.obj.left).ι).obj
          (H.integralExchange Q).stage.tensorY ≅
        (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj
          (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E Q.Y.obj.left).ι).obj
            (sfIntegralConstructible C.l E Q.Y.obj.left).ι).obj
              (Functor.curry.obj aY.tensor)),
      Adjunction.ComparisonCompatible a (H.integralExchange Q).stage.tensorPullback.hom
        (ordinaryCurriedTensorPullback (PurCompactSupport.completed C.l E)
          Q.p.hom.left aZ aY).hom m n
